# Feature: Dark room — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #51 (Dark room) from Vision and Information before it is used in real levels. Effect: only tiles near Jolly are lit. Unique: limits vision across the whole room at once. Useful: hides layout so memory and searching lead. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** only tiles near Jolly are lit.

**So that** hides layout so memory and searching lead.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Dark room for the first time in its teaching room (mech-51-dark-room-room). Teaching moment: First room: a dark room with an orb placed outside the light that surrounds the entrance. A player who follows the visible floor reaches the gate with one orb still missing and has to return, which teaches that the absence of a tile from view is not evidence that nothing is there. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Tiles beyond two tiles from Jolly are not drawn at all in this room
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The HUD still shows
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The radius is the whole mechanic, so layout must be learned by walking it

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Dark room's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-51-dark-room-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/vision-and-information.yml mechanic #51.
